purpose: Review high-geometric-evidence pairs currently absent from active ground truth.

review_instructions.confirm: Set review_status to confirmed if the pair is the same physical property.
review_instructions.reject: Set review_status to rejected if the pair is only visually similar or shares a reused marketing image.
review_instructions.then: Confirmed pairs should be added to CONFIRMED_PAIRS in matcher scripts and MATCHES.md before rerunning benchmarks.
